Come raise a stein! Order Online! Bier to Celebrate New Bier Every Month! Join us the first week of every month to tap a fresh keg of one of our authentic Bavarian biers. Check out our events to see what we’re tapping next. See you at our Haus! Bavarian Food Authentic Bavarian Favorites Our award-winning menu has something for everyone… whether it’s a traditional Bavarian favorite like schnitzel or bratwurst… or one of the best burgers around! Finish it off with one of our huge, delicious cream puffs! Bier Clubs For the Connoisseur Our 1589 Growler Club and Stein Master Club memberships offer special access to our freshly-brewed biers as well as exclusive offers, discounts and events. Brewed for America’s 250th Anniversary, Liberty Light Lager honors the cultures that helped shape the nation – especially the deep German roots that influenced America’s early bier traditions. A lighter, crisp take on our classic Hofbräuhaus Lager, it’s full-flavored, refreshing and clean – crafted with the same time-honored methods our Munich brewery has used for more than 400 years.
